t: r/Marvel on Reddit: marvel fans:how broken is X-Men Darwin ability?
s: February 6, 2023 - Reminder that Darwin's introduction was him surviving an event that wiped out the rest of his team. It's very easy to write this guy into tragic scenarios. In a sense, his superpower is survivor's guilt. ... Yeah but I actually wonder what he's doing with the x men. His power is only about protecting himself, so if he's no use to a team, then what does he do for the x men ? Also, Xavier's school is all about helping mutants learn to control their powers and Darwin's power is literally impossible to control so it kinda defies the purpose of the school.
